name: Fey Wanderer Spells
description:
When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Fey Wanderer Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Level 3: Charm Person

Level 5: Misty Step

Level 9: Summon Fey

Level 13: Dimension Door

Level 17: Mislead

You also possess a fey blessing. Choose it from the Feywild Gifts table or determine it randomly.

Level 1: Illusory butterflies flutter around you while you take a Short or Long Rest.

Level 2: Flowers bloom from your hair each dawn.

Level 3: You faintly smell of cinnamon, lavender, nutmeg, or another comforting herb or spice.

Level 4: Your shadow dances while no one is looking directly at it.

Level 5: Horns or antlers sprout from your head.

Level 6: Your skin and hair change color each dawn.
